channel.title: Podcasting Morning Show | Podcast Growth, Launch and Strategy for Indie Podcasters
channel.description: The Podcasting Morning Show helps indie podcasters, creators, consultants, and entrepreneurs start, grow, improve, and monetize their shows. Hosted by 20+ year podcast pro Marc Ronick, it’s a morning show meets mastermind group, with veteran podcasters sharing real strategies, tools, trends, hard lessons, and what’s worked or failed. Episodes cover podcast growth, launch strategy, audience building, content planning, interviews, video podcasting, AI tools, monetization, community, podcast news, and the business of podcasting for creators who want better listeners, content, and results.

item.title: 557. The Cost of Coming Back Before You’re Ready
item.description:
Sometimes giving yourself space changes the answer you thought you already had.

In this short update, I share what this time away from the Podcasting Morning Show has been revealing to me, how recent experiences have shifted my perspective, and why I’m thinking differently about what comes next.

I also talk about creativity, community, and some new possibilities I’ve started exploring along the way.

I wanted to check in, share where things stand, and bring you along for what comes next.

Want to work with me on your podcast or community?

Email me at marc@ironickmedia.com

item.title: Why Podcasting Is Becoming a Powerful Career Tool
item.description:
Building a powerful career tool starts with podcasting. In this conversation, Annika Jackson explains why podcasts are becoming more than just content platforms—they're helping professionals showcase expertise, build personal brands, develop valuable skills, and stand out in today's competitive job market. Discover how creating a podcast can open new career opportunities, strengthen your professional credibility, and become an asset that grows long after each episode is published.

Episode Highlights:

[04:39] Annika's Updates and New Shows

[06:47] Why Your Podcast Is the New Resume

[10:17] Building a Podcast Curriculum at USC

[15:38] Why the Media Industry Is Embracing Podcasts

[19:13] Threads and Organic Promotion

[23:22] Student Mindset and Analytics

[32:00] Annika's Revenue Cascade Strategy

[33:21] Monetizing Beyond Ads

[36:36] Building Intentional Growth Systems

item.title: 556. How to Improve Your Podcast Intro, Interviews & Pacing
item.description:
A great conversation can lose listeners before it ever gets started, which is why it's worth learning how to Improve Your Podcast Intro while also sharpening your interview skills and pacing. The morning show cast and crew break down what makes an intro grab attention, how to ask stronger questions that lead to better conversations, and why slowing down at the right moments keeps listeners engaged. By the end, you'll have simple ideas you can apply to create a stronger first impression and a more engaging podcast from start to finish.


Episode Highlights:

[06:46] Nikki Joins the Hot Seat

[08:06] First Impressions and Audience Clarity

[11:50] Branding Fixes: Tagline and Cover Art

[18:50] Intro Clip and Opening Feedback

[23:55] Pacing, Confidence, and Delivery Tips

[29:37] The One-Question Hook

[31:30] Talk to One Person, Not Everyone

[41:34] Transitioning into Key Takeaways

[46:22] Interview Style Review

[48:40] Avoiding Stacked Questions
